tasks.short: Counsel students on personal, academic, vocational, or behavioural concerns

steps.what: Receive concern and check student record
Arrange private meeting and safeguarding route

tasks.design: First configure confidential case fields, a meeting reminder and a follow-up date in {HCM} and {CALENDAR}. The administrator still assesses risk, listens to the student and agrees any support or referral; the workflow only prepares and records the case.
tasks.previous_blocker: The core work is a sensitive conversation, not an information-routing problem.
tasks.enabler_now: A confidential case record can carry the minimum facts and prevent missed follow-up.
tasks.still_hard: Risk assessment, trust and deciding whether to involve others remain with the administrator.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator notices distress, earns trust and takes responsibility for a safe next step.

ambition.what: Offer every student a recorded follow-up rather than losing low-urgency concerns between meetings.

tasks.altitude: The administrator spends less time scheduling and writing case notes, and more time reviewing whether support is working.

evidence.claim: Confidential records and reminders can support case follow-up without deciding the case.
Sensitive education decisions require meaningful human intervention.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: concern received through follow-up recorded after the meeting.

Input contract: student identifier, concern category, date, reporter and urgency; producer is the student, parent or staff member; a private manual note is the fallback when a structured form is unsafe.
Access to confidential student data is restricted before configuration is tested.
Incremental upkeep of 1.5 hours per 100 baseline hours covers reminder and category review.
unknowns: Which safeguarding policy and referral roles apply at the school.
Whether the current student record can hold restricted case notes.
research_questions: How often are follow-up dates currently missed?
Which concern categories must never be routed automatically?

already_counted.description: Meeting preparation, confidential guidance and support planning

incremental.description: Review reminder categories and exception routes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The student conversation and support decision remain fully human; the low case assumes meeting setup still needs manual coordination.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Confer with parents and staff about activities, policy, behaviour, or learning

steps.what: Collect attendance, work and incident records
Agree actions, owners and review date

tasks.design: A {WORKFLOW} form compiles selected records, creates a meeting pack and sends the agreed action list through {EMAIL}. The administrator conducts the conference and decides the actions; no system interprets behaviour or makes a student decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: The meeting depends on relationships, conflicting accounts and a context-specific agreement.
tasks.enabler_now: Calendar, record and reminder links can remove the administrative preparation around the conference.
tasks.still_hard: Parents and staff may disagree, and the administrator must explain and adapt the next step.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator creates a constructive conversation and balances the student's interests with policy and practical constraints.

ambition.what: Review overdue actions from parent and staff conferences every week.

tasks.altitude: The administrator sees follow-through across cases instead of chasing separate email threads.

reach.task: prepare evidence for a parent conference

evidence.claim: Meeting invitations, action lists and reminders can be configured as a workflow.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: meeting request through distribution of the agreed action record.

Input contract: student identifier, participants, purpose, factual observations and proposed dates; staff or a parent produces the request; the administrator can create the pack manually when records are incomplete.
Incremental upkeep of 2 hours per 100 baseline hours covers templates and access review.
unknowns: Whether calls, video meetings or in-person conferences are standard.
research_questions: How much preparation is spent locating records?
What action fields make follow-through visible without exposing sensitive notes?

incremental.description: Maintain meeting templates and participant permissions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The conference and agreement remain human; the range depends on how consistently records can be assembled before the meeting.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Observe teaching and materials to improve curriculum and teaching techniques

steps.what: Select observation focus and request materials

loop.output: feedback draft grouped by observation focus
loop.check: Administrator checks every claim against notes before sharing.
loop.stop: One draft only; unsupported statements are removed and the administrator writes the feedback manually.
loop.why_not_simpler: The evidence is free-text notes and teaching materials rather than fixed fields.

steps.what: Log actions and schedule curriculum review

tasks.design: A {DOCS} checklist collects teaching materials and a {WORKFLOW} register tracks agreed improvement actions. A bounded draft can organise the administrator's own observation notes, but classroom observation, curriculum judgement and feedback remain theirs.
tasks.previous_blocker: Teaching quality is situational and cannot be inferred from a checklist alone.
tasks.enabler_now: A shared observation format and action register reduce repeated document handling.
tasks.still_hard: A useful judgement must account for pupils, subject, teacher choices and local curriculum intent.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator observes what happened in the room and gives credible developmental feedback.

ambition.what: Give each teaching team a quarterly view of recurring curriculum improvement themes.

tasks.altitude: The administrator compares patterns across observations rather than compiling action lists by hand.

evidence.claim: A bounded draft can organise source notes for human checking.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: observation focus selected through review date recorded.

Input contract: class, subject, observation focus, lesson date, materials and administrator notes; teacher supplies materials and the administrator supplies notes; an offline checklist is the fallback.
Incremental upkeep of 3 hours per 100 baseline hours covers the observation rubric and action categories.
unknowns: Which curriculum standards and observation rubric are already approved.
Whether teachers may view notes before they become part of a shared action record.
research_questions: Which action themes repeat across classes?
How much time is spent compiling materials before an observation?

already_counted.description: Observation, curriculum assessment and feedback review

incremental.description: Maintain observation rubric and action categories

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Observation and curriculum judgement remain manual; savings come from preparation, drafting and action tracking.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Scope educational offerings and draft schedules, descriptions, staffing, and facility requirements

steps.what: Collect enrolment, prior courses and room capacity

loop.input: approved programme assumptions and course data
loop.check: Administrator checks course conflicts, wording and assumptions against the planning dataset.
loop.stop: One draft per planning cycle; conflicts or missing data return to manual planning.
loop.why_not_simpler: Course descriptions require free-text drafting while schedule inputs require structured constraints.

tasks.design: First configure scheduling and capacity rules in the existing planning tools. A {SPREADSHEET} model then tests course, staff and room constraints from a single planning dataset, while {DOCS} produces a reviewable planning pack; leadership choices remain outside the automation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Course scope, staffing and room trade-offs were spread across documents and local spreadsheets.
tasks.enabler_now: Structured enrolment, capacity and availability fields can feed repeatable scenarios.
tasks.still_hard: The administrator must make trade-offs between curriculum value, staffing constraints and local needs.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator judges which programme mix serves pupils and is practical for staff and facilities.

ambition.what: Compare viable course and capacity scenarios before each planning cycle.

tasks.altitude: The administrator tests scenarios and challenges assumptions rather than assembling one static schedule.

reach.learn: planning data quality and constraint rules

evidence.claim: Structured scheduling tools can support course and capacity planning.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: planning inputs collected through planning pack prepared for leadership review.

Input contract: course code, expected enrolment, duration, staff availability, room capacity and course description; academic and facilities staff produce the fields; a controlled spreadsheet is the fallback for missing integrations.
Native scheduling configuration is tested before custom scenario code.
Incremental upkeep of 4 hours per 100 baseline hours covers term-rule, capacity and course-catalogue changes.
unknowns: Which scheduling system and constraint rules are currently used.
Who has authority to approve programme scope, staffing changes and room use.
research_questions: How often do late enrolment changes force a schedule rebuild?
Which constraints are reliable enough to calculate without manual reconciliation?

already_counted.description: Programme choice, draft review and planning-pack review

incremental.description: Maintain term rules, capacities and course catalogue

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Programme scope remains a human decision; the range assumes different completeness of enrolment, staff and room data.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The administrator protects student-facing and curriculum judgement while using reliable planning and follow-up records.
reach: Partner with student support specialists on referral triage.
Partner with facilities coordinators on capacity data.
role.ambitious_version: A school leader who sees follow-through, curriculum themes and viable programme scenarios in time to act.
